narration: Every time you tap your phone to pay, something weird happens — your brain barely notices the money leaving. And that tiny glitch is costing you thousands a year.
visual: Hand silhouette tapping phone to payment terminal SVG. Dollar signs float upward and fade. 'YOUR BRAIN BARELY NOTICES' badge springs in. Dark background, orange accent.

narration: MIT researchers call it the pain of paying. Physical cash triggers real discomfort — it's a natural spending brake. Digital payments kill that friction entirely.
visual: Brain SVG center frame. Left side: hand holding cash with red 'PAIN' pulse lines radiating. Right side: tap payment with green 'NO SIGNAL' flat line. Light background.

narration: The numbers are wild. Same people, same products — but cashless shoppers spent 83% more than cash shoppers. Not a little more. Eighty-three percent more.
visual: Two bar charts rise side by side. Left bar labeled 'CASH' rises to half height in gray. Right bar labeled 'CASHLESS' rises to full height in orange with '83% MORE' badge. Dark background.

narration: Think about your own week. Coffee, lunch, quick Amazon order, streaming add-on. Each tap felt like nothing. Add them up and the damage is real.
visual: Four SVG icons appear sequentially: coffee cup, burger, delivery box, play button. Each pops in with a small price tag. A running total counter climbs at bottom. Light background.

narration: Across the year, researchers put the average cashless overspend at around $2,400. That's a flight to Europe. A month of rent. Just gone, one tap at a time.
visual: Piggy bank SVG cracks open. Coins fly out forming $2,400 figure. Three comparison icons: airplane, house, stack of cash — each labeled. Dark background.

narration: You don't have to go full cash. Just use it for one spending category — groceries, eating out, whatever you overspend on. The discomfort kicks back in and you'll spend less without even trying.
visual: Wallet SVG opens to show cash bills on one side, card on other. Arrow points to cash side with 'USE HERE' label and category icons. 'SAVE $200/MONTH' badge springs in. Light background.
